# incusos_system_security (Resource)

Manages IncusOS system security configuration (`/1.0/system/security`), including custom CA certificates and disk encryption recovery keys.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_ca_certs` (List of String) List of PEM-encoded custom CA certificates trusted by the OS.
- `encryption_recovery_keys` (List of String, Sensitive) List of disk encryption recovery passphrases.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secure_boot_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Secure Boot is enabled.
- `system_state_is_trusted` (Boolean) Whether the system state is currently trusted.
- `system_state_status` (String) Current system security state status.
- `tpm_status` (String) Current TPM status (`ok`, `pcr mismatch`, `swtpm`).
